{{Quote|This is the Lake of Apparitions, perhaps you see why?|[[Seek Ryontarr]] to [[Ben Skywalker]] after seeing rocks cast reflections of living organisms in the lake|<ref name="Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>}}
The '''Lake of Apparitions''' was a lake that existed in a realm of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] known as [[beyond shadows]]. Any being who walked across the Lake had to step carefully, or they would sink into the [[Depths of Eternity]], from which they couldn't be saved. While walking across it the spirits of [[Death/Legends|deceased]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] could be seen on the surface of the [[Water/Legends|water]], known as the [[Mirror of Remembrance]]. Over the Lake hung heavy mists, which were known as the [[Mists of Forgetfulness]].<ref name="Abyss" />

[[File:Mara_Force-Ghost.jpg|thumb|right|120px|Mara Jade Skywalker's spirit in the Lake of Apparitions]]
While on their journey to discover what had caused [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] to turn to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] as Darth Caedus, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]] traveled to [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]], where they found [[Sinkhole Station]], a small [[Space station/Legends|space station]] resembling [[Centerpoint Station]] that was home to the [[Mind Walkers]]&mdash;a group of Force-sensitives who could [[Mind Walking|separate their minds]] from their physical beings in order to go beyond shadows. When Luke and Ben went beyond shadows with the Mind Walkers, they traveled to the Lake of Apparitions, where they talked to the spirits of [[Anakin Solo]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], and a once-more peaceful Jacen Solo.<ref name="Abyss" />

Later, after arriving on [[Abeloth's planet|Abeloth's world]] on a [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] with the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] to eliminate [[Abeloth]], the Skywalkers realized that every location they had seen beyond shadows corresponded to an actual location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. On Abeloth's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], the Skywalkers Mind Walked with [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|Sith High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]], [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]], and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Leeha Faal]], and again they entered the Lake of Apparitions. There, the Jedi and Sith both encountered many of their deceased friends, and Skywalker again saw and spoke briefly with his wife. However, Faal also met some of her deceased enemies, who dragged her into the Depths of Eternity, killing her.<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>

Skywalker later returned to duel Abeloth again during the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|Liberation of Coruscant]], and received the help of [[Darth Krayt]], though Krayt's identity, beyond being a Sith Lord not of the Lost Tribe, was unknown to Skywalker at the time, and his deceased wife, where they were able to, albeit temporarily, defeat her.<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>
